name: Bought land
title: freehold
text: You scraped together the price of a plot. The land is yours outright, with a tent camp on it.

name: Inherited a house
title: freehold
text: A relative left you a cottage and the family name. Landed gentry pay more tax and keep clear of menial work.

name: Arrived with nothing
title: leasehold
text: You came to town with a few pennies. The Crown lets you camp on a plot for rent. Find work quickly.
